Dialogs.Dialog: Phew... Put in a good day's work today!
Good work today. We really worked hard, didn't we？ Wonder if someone'll give us a reward？
Speaking of rewards, I actually won another one!
Oh, Nikko-Kinugawa？ Or Atami？ You can't surprise me anymore, you know？
This time it's Hakone. A two-day, one-night 'Rediscover the Domestic Honeymoon' trip!!
Honeymoon, as in... like for newlyweds？
Apparently back in the Showa thirties, Hakone and Atami were the honeymoon spots.
It's a couples' tour to revisit those places, or so it says.
It's not that, but... Do you realize what you're saying...？
Uh... so the 'honeymoon' part is bugging you？
I know it's just the theme of the tour, of course, but still...
Right, right. It's no different from our other trips, right？
I know, but hearing you say it so bluntly makes me conscious of it! I can't just give you an answer right away!
Hey... About what we were talking about earlier？
It's not 'real', right？ Like... just playing pretend...
Geez... So, when are we going？
(Since it's a honeymoon, I'll save our date for another day...)
All right. Starting ▲月▲▲日▲, a two-day honeymoon!
Phew... Done with work for today!
There, there. You worked hard today.
Right？ Will you give me a reward？ Hehe.
(Oh, right! Maybe I should invite her on that Hakone sweepstakes trip I won again...)
Actually, I won again! The 'Rediscover Honeymoons: 2 Days, 1 Night in Hakone' trip!
The odds are crazy, but we're used to it by now!
W-Well, yeah... Still, hmm... I see.
Huh？ Not feeling up for it？
I mean, look... Going so many times... Doesn't that seem unlucky？
I guess... Hey, we're just pretending. Think of it like practice.
Practice, huh... I see. Just... practice, right？
Hey, if it's pretend, we're doing that again, okay？
You know, like last time... the whole trip... okay？
All right! Well then, when should we go...？
(Let's save normal dates for another time... Since it's a honeymoon.)
All right. Starting ▲月▲▲日▲, it's a two-day, one-night honeymoon!
Geez... Could you say that a little more romantically, please？
Let's go on our honeymoon starting ▲月▲▲日▲, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hey, it's a honeymoon, right？ Even if it's pretend.
You mean Hakone？ Well, yeah, pretty much.
Then wanna go shopping for a bit？ Right now.
Shopping, huh？ It's only one night, though. Do we need anything？
I know, but... Mm, well, anyway, let's just go, okay？
We bought the guidebook. Is there... anything else？
That's why we're pretending! Just like a real honeymoon.
We'll pick out a big suitcase for the two of us, and stuff we'd share, then pretend to buy them. Okay？
I see... All right, let's do it!
Phew... We sure bought a lot, huh？ Just pretending, though. Hehe!
I guess？ Still, a pink suitcase for ● is a little...
Oh, that's fine. It was right there in that honeymoon magazine special!
They said it's convenient because you can spot yours right away when you check bags on a plane or a bus.
It's starting to feel real, isn't it？ I can't wait!
Well, I'm gonna pick up a few things before heading home, so I'll leave you here, okay？
(I probably shouldn't tag along here, right？ All right, time to head home!)
(I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is already here？)
Phew... It's so humid out already, isn't it？
True, but... people always talk about June, don't they？ June something-or-other... right？
Just pretend, of course! We're just playing pretend, yep.
Good morning. It really is a bit chilly, isn't it？
Yeah, it'll probably be even colder over there.
Hakone in the fall foliage... Yeah, that does sound romantic. You know, for "that"... right？
Jeez... Well, even if it is just pretend？
Right. Even if it is pretend, it's still a honeymoon...
Yeah... Take good care of me, okay？
Hehe! All right, and off we go!
It doesn't really feel like a honeymoon, does it？ So far, at least.
Well, we're just on our usual train, aren't we？
Well, true. It won't really start until we're on the express train. Yep, can't wait!
Oh, hey, is this it？ This is what we're riding？
...Well？ Starting to feel like a honeymoon yet？
Yeah. I mean, it is a "Romancecar"! Hehe!
Hey, hey, we're riding the "Romancecar" this time too, right？
Looks like you really took a liking to the "Romancecar."
Well, it's romance, after all! Hehe!
Ooh, the "Romancecar" really is so cool!
Yeah, it is cool. Hehe, even with a name like "Romancecar."
Right？ And hey, did you notice？ There's no armrest in the middle.
Oh, now that you mention it... Usually they just fold up, but there isn't one at all...
Right？ I was just thinking, things like this are what make it all about "romance."
Right？ It just naturally brings us closer together, doesn't it▼
Man... Limited expresses really are the best!
Yeah. It's really starting to feel like a honeymoon.
See, we just can't help getting closer together. The Romancecar really is magical▼
Hey, hey, where are we around now？
I see. So the ocean is further ahead？
Unlike when we went to Atami, we're heading inland.
Oh yeah, speaking of Atami... remember how we played pretend honeymoon？
But this time, we're taking it way further, okay？ Deal？
Well... Yup, I'll think of something as we go.
Oh, right! Speaking of Atami, you didn't play along, did you？ Our pretend honeymoon, I mean.
Ah... Now that you mention it.
You won't get away with it this time, okay？ That's what this trip is for! ...Got it？ Hehe.
(It's a little embarrassing, but I'll do my best...)
Oh yeah. On our last honeymoon, could we see the ocean near Hakone？
Yeah, I'm pretty sure we could.
Hehe, it sounds so funny saying “our last honeymoon.”
Who cares, though？ Fun things are great no matter how many times you do them. Let's have a blast, okay？ Hehe!
We will soon arrive at the final stop, Hakone-Yumoto. For the Hakone Tozan Line bound for Gora...
Ah, see, Hakone-Yumoto! That's where we get off, right？
All right! Let's get our stuff ready!
Wow... Out of everywhere we've been, this feels the most like a real tourist spot.
Yeah. It is Hakone, after all...
There are so many souvenir shops. I wonder how far they go...
Shall we go take a look？
We're newlyweds, remember？ Would you just walk off alone like that on a real honeymoon？
(I'm happy, but it's a little embarrassing...)
Yup, here we are in Hakone... Hehe!
Nothing at all？ I was just remembering our last honeymoon, that's all.
Aw, you're blushing. ...Though I am, too. Hey, what do we do first？
(Honeymoons really are great! Even if it's just pretend!)
'Hydrangea Bridge.' Look, they're blooming along the riverbank!
So many different colors. They're gorgeous... Oh, right, I saw this on TV.
They said Hakone has lots of hydrangeas, and this is their peak season.
Now that you mention it, I saw some from the train.
I bet we'll see plenty during our trip, don't you think？
Hydrangea Bridge in June... Hehe, it's so lovely. How romantic▼
Yeah. Mm... As expected, no hydrangeas are blooming？
Instead, look! The leaves have started turning here and there. So pretty...
Yeah. I bet it's even prettier higher up...
Right？ We're on our honeymoon in autumn Hakone, after all？
We've gotta enjoy the fall colors while we eat! Hehe▼
It's a little early, but let's grab some lunch around here.
Ooh, me, me! I want to eat yuba!
Yup. We had it in Nikko, too, but Hakone's famous for it, too, you know？
Yuba, huh... All right, let's look for—
Here! This is where I wanted to go. 'Yubadon Naokichi.' Okay？
Sure, but... did you know this place, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
To tell the truth, yeah？ I looked it up in a guide. Come on, let's head in!
Whoa... You can see the Hayakawa from here...
Right？ Isn't it nice？ Plus, they say their yuba is made with spring water called 'Princess Water.'
I see. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you decide what you want to order yet？
Thank you for waiting. Here is your Yuba Bowl and Sashimi set, and the Yuba Soba.
Right？ This way, we get yuba bowl, yuba sashimi, and yuba soba, every single one!
We're sharing everything! After all... aren't we newlyweds？
Hehe... Here, have a bite？ Say ahhh...
'Yuba-don Naokichi'. Come on, let's go in？
Now then, what should we order today？
Today it's 'Yuba Soba' and the 'Yuba Bowl + Sashimi Set' again.
All yuba again, huh？ That's actually quite a lot of food, right？
Yup！ I'll have a bit of each, and you eat plenty, okay？
Thank you for waiting. Here's your Yuba Bowl and Sashimi Set, and Yuba Soba.
Here you go, dig in？ Say ahhh...
That was delicious. Phew... I ate way too much.
Hey, hey, we're going to the Hakone Glass Forest Museum, right？
Yeah. We'll take the Hakone Tozan Railway to Gora.
Ah, so cute! That train？ We're going up the mountain on that？
Huh... It's pretty powerful for how it looks.
Next is the Hakone Glass Forest Museum？ Taking that train again？
Yeah. On the Hakone Tozan Railway, all the way to Gora.
There it is! It's so cute~!
Work hard climbing up again, okay？
We ate a bit too much for lunch today, though... Will you be okay？ Hehe!
Wow, look! We're riding right through the hydrangeas!
I wonder why there are so many blooming... Did someone plant them？
I see... How sweet of them. Oh, look, look! Again!
What a steep hill! Can you make it？ You can do it! Hehe!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks so happy. We picked a great time to visit!)
So pretty... The autumn leaves are gorgeous...
Yeah... It really feels like autumn. So nice...
It really does... Hey, doesn't it make you want to write a haiku？
I'll go first, then. Let's see... Autumn leaves...
...Nope, got nothing! Hehe! Oh, look, another steep hill! Hang in there, train~!
We're here! Last stop, Gora Station!
Ah... Maybe I dressed too light？ It feels cooler here than Hakone-Yumoto.
Yeah, we came up pretty high, after all.
The train worked so hard, didn't it？ Hehe. What do we do from here again？
We take a bus to the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
Aw, did you forget already？ Link arms with me!
(Ah, so soft... She could've dressed even lighter, though.)
We're here! Last stop, Gora Station!
Whoa, it's cold! Definitely colder than down below!
Really feels like we're in Hakone now.
Brrr! So chiiiilly... We take a bus now, right？
Right. To the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
(Yeah. Though, the season for lighter clothes really would be nice...)
Whoa, that's quite a steep hill...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're okay going uphill, right？
I'm fine. Besides, sitting close like this, you know...
Doesn't it really feel like we're on our honeymoon？
Do you think... someone saw us just now？
Can't be helped, right？ I mean, we're on our honeymoon. Hehe▼
Next stop: Hyoseki - Hakone Glass Forest...
Hyoseki - Hakone Glass Forest. Please be sure not to leave anything behind...
The Hakone Glass Forest Museum. So this is it...
Yeah, it looks like a real European building. Not that I've ever been...
Hey, look at that glass tree! It sparkles so much... Is it electric lights？
I think it's just the sun reflecting. Ah, makes sense, a forest of glass!
Hey, look at this! Look at the ticket! That's so neat▼
They really put some detail into it!
Hyoseki - Hakone Glass Forest. Please be sure not to leave anything behind...
We're here. The Hakone Glass Forest Museum!
Look, look! The crystal glass tree... It's gorgeous...
Even though it's just sunlight, how does it shine in so many colors...？
…… Please take your time and enjoy your visit.
Oh, hey, look at this! It's not like the last one! Makes you wanna collect them, doesn't it？
You're right. They really put a lot of work into these, as usual...
Wow... It feels like we're not even in Japan!
Yeah... Apparently the whole place is modeled after Venice.
I see... Hey, look at all the sparkles! Let's go check it out？
Look, look at this! A glass hydrangea!
Uh, 'Ortensia', huh？ It says it's made of 2,000 crystal glass beads.
Two thousand! Wow... Having it right by the real hydrangeas is so stylish▼
Oh, look at this! The pampas grass is glass!
Glass pampas grass, huh... Each stalk has 100 crystal beads, and there are 100 plants!?
So pretty... They sway when the wind blows... It really feels like autumn...
It says 'Corridor of Light'! So pretty...
Nine meters high, ten long. 160,000 crystal beads!?
They're swaying in the breeze... I wonder how it sparkles in so many different colors...
I know! Hey, hey... Let's take a picture？
When we walk through here, you know what we have to do... right？
Mmm! I really love this! A Venice made of glass!
Great view of the mountains, too! Is that smoke from Owakudani？
Look, look at this! A glass hydrangea!
Uh, 'Ortensia', huh？ It says it's made of 2,000 crystal glass beads.
Two thousand! Wow... Having it right by the real hydrangeas is so stylish▼
Oh, look at this! The pampas grass is glass!
Glass pampas grass, huh... Each stalk has 100 crystal beads, and there are 100 plants!?
So pretty... They sway when the wind blows... It really feels like autumn...
Wow, it's so sparkly today, too...
All right, when we walk through here, we have to...？
I'm so lucky to have such a sweet husband▼ Hehe!
What an amazing chandelier. It's like a European noble's mansion in the movies...
Hey, look at this! It's so intricate! It's a mosaic of flowers!
'Millefiori'... It means 'a thousand flowers'. Said to date back to ancient Rome.
Ancient Rome, huh... I wonder how they make it... It's not painted on, right？
'Lidded Goblet with Stippled Floral Pattern'？ That means a cup, right？ Did nobles drink wine from this？
You'd feel guilty if you didn't pour really pricey wine in it, right？ Oh, look!
When you look from behind, the light shines through into cobalt blue! So pretty...
So this is the museum shop.
Ooh, I wanna look! Come on, can we？
Look, crystal glassware trinkets... Wait, is that a millefiori plate？
Huh, looks like you combine glass pieces and melt them together. Wanna try it？
All done! A masterpiece! I wonder what it'll look like once it melts？
Looks like it'll take a while before it's done firing.
Wanna take a break at the restaurant？
How nice... I wonder if Italian cafes feel like this？ Uh, Caffe Teratte？
Thank you for waiting. Here is your fruit tea.
So cute! Look at all the fruit!
And it's made for two, right？ Perfect for honeymooners. Isn't it？ Hehe▼
Thank you for waiting. It turned out beautifully, you know？
Thank you so much! ...Let's see here...
Mm-hmm, looks great! Nene Fiore is complete! Hehe!
We still have time. Wanna look around a bit more？
Look at this! A glass fountain... It says "Fontana"!
Whoa... Forty-five thousand glass beads, huh. I'm getting used to it now.
Jeez, forget the numbers! Just look at it and enjoy how pretty it is. Right？
Hm？ Hey, over there. What's that？
Oh, so like the thing at Cape Aijo？
It doesn't really say anything like that, though...
Look, though？ Looks like you ring it by pulling from both ends together!
We each make a vow in our hearts. Secret, okay？ Though... as honeymooners, it has to be the same, right？
...Did we make the same vow, you think？
Fontana! The glass fountain is sparkling today, too! Heheh!
Oh yeah, what about the 'Bell of Vows'？
We're going, right？ Of course we are？
...Did we make the same vow, you think？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you a little tired？
Mm, a bit. Maybe I got a little too excited.
I get it. It really is a great place.
Yeah, I love it. Oh, is that our bus？
Won't you please tell me？ Your secret vow earlier. I'm really curious!
No, never mind. The mood is important, right？ Yeah...
Next is the final stop, Togendai, Togendai. Hakone Ropeway, Lake...
Wow, amazing! This is Lake Ashi, right？
What were we doing next？ Want to go check it out？
Let's check in first. After this, we're just staying at the hotel.
Right, right... Just staying at the hotel, huh.
No, nothing! It's just, well... Kind of gets you a bit nervous, doesn't it？
(When she says that, ● gets kind of nervous, too...)
Look, there it is. Right here—the 'Hakone Lake Hotel'!
Yeah. Really feels like a resort.
A hot spring inn is nice, but a honeymoon's gotta be like this, right？
Alright, take me inside, darling▼ Heheh!
Now then, escort me, hubby. Heheh!
Look, look! Wow, what a chandelier! It's European-style here, too？
I see... Hakone must have a lot of European-style spots.
Well, I'll go check us in.
Then we have the same last name, right？
Hey, hey, did you write it down？
I wrote it properly？ “▲苗字▲ Nene”.
Aah~ hearing you say it out loud is so embarrassing!
Thank you for waiting. Shall I explain our facilities to your wife as well？
Yes, please, if you wouldn't mind？
Hey... did I seem like a wife just now？
(Totally did... This might be pretty nice!)
Well, I'll go check us in.
Ah, you know what to do, right？ The name？
Did you write it right？ With the same last name.
I wrote it properly？ “▲苗字▲ Nene”.
Mmm... I'm not used to this at all, hehe.
Thank you for waiting. Shall I explain our facilities to your wife as well？
No, um... My husband will tell me.
Well, I just really wanted to say “my husband”...
Yeah. Tatami and futons feel more relaxing anyway, right？
You're right, yeah! I'm gonna roll around on the futon!
Oh, look! The mountains outside are so pretty？ They look so close!
Maybe 'cause we're high up？ I love views like this!
Um... Just a tiny bit, yeah？
Oh, I'll make us some tea, okay？
It's nothing, really. Just thinking how happy I am. ...Though...
If we were real newlyweds, this is how our life would be every single day, you know？
Just wanted to say it. Hehe!
Hey, hey, want to hit the baths before dinner？
We've got some time, so why not？
Men's is 'Heaven' and women's is 'Sky', huh... If we were newlyweds, we'd go in together—
Oh right, we're only playing pretend...
Pervert, hehe. Hey, let's meet up at the lobby, okay？
An outdoor bath! Nothing beats being outside...
Hey, there's something that looks like a cocoon over here？
A cocoon？ Oh, there's one here too. Wonder what it is？
Oh! Maybe I'll try it out？
Nene-chan's gonna hop into this stone tub over here~ ...Hup.
I'll leave that to your imagination~!
Pheeew... That was a nice bath.
Geez... Don't be in awe every single time!
Let's link arms and explore the hotel, okay？
Oh, a relaxation room. Want to take a peek inside？
Ack... Nooo, that tickles! I can't, no way, no way!
If you're that ticklish, you shouldn't have done it...
I couldn't help it, hehe! Hey, want to check out the gift shop？
Hakone specialties, huh. There's so much here...
There's marquetry, onsen steamed buns... Oh, hot spring bath salts! Should I get some of these？
Hot springs in your bath at home？
Yep. Whenever Mom goes to an onsen with friends, she always buys some.
She says eating dinner with that onsen vibe makes it taste better.
Hey... It's kind of a grown-up atmosphere, isn't it？
Thank you for waiting. Here is your pork loin sanzokuyaki.
Ugh... I think I'm totally full. And I really tried, too...
Wait, isn't that wrong？ Come on, remember what we are right now...？
Now open wide, please～ Say ahh▼
Thanks for the meal. Phew, I'm stuffed...
Ugh～ I think I ate too much...
The food was really good, though.
I know! That's why on trips, you just can't help it... *sigh*...
Let's rest a bit. Want me to make some tea？
You can't do that. I'm the one making the tea.
Because, well... I'm your newlywed wife, aren't I？
R-Right... Well, I'll leave it to you, then.
Oh, hey, hey？ Want to take a walk down by the lake？
Might be just the thing to walk off dinner... Shall we go？
Hey, look. The hotel's all lit up.
Doesn't it make you feel a little grown-up？ Hehe, let's go♪
But look, the boats and distant lights are so pretty...
Back when lots of newlyweds visited Hakone, they'd all walk like this and――
Talked about the new life they were starting together, right？ I bet they did.
Like what kind of house they'd want, or how many kids they should have...
What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What do you want？
Hmm... A small house is fine, as long as our family gets to travel a lot.
For kids, definitely a boy. One who takes after you. ...The kind you can't leave alone？
But he'd be so sweet, and have a lovely smile you'd just want to eat up...
Hey, there were so many families on the boat, right？ Like dads giving shoulder rides.
Oh yeah, totally! Looked like hard work, though...
You'll do that someday too, you know？ Once you have kids.
Hehe, right？ Kind of hard to imagine, isn't it？
But I'm sure it'll just naturally start suiting you.
Mm, don't worry. I'm sure you'll make a wonderful dad, you know？
You'll make a wonderful mom too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Even when you're a dad, you can't forget things like this, okay？
Uh-oh？ Could it be... you're scared？
In movies, when couples get bold and wander into lakeside woods, usually...
Sure, but... are you okay, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Ah, blaming it on me! Scaredy-cat!
In movies, right from the shade of those trees on the left, suddenly――
It's okay, it's just a branch!
I know, I did it on purpose! Don't you understand a girl's heart at all？
Well then... It's still early for bed, what should we do？
Should we lay out the futons？
I mean, look... The night is long, you know？
Isn't it nicer to lay out the futons and just lounge around？
Hey... Aren't these futons a little too close？
I don't... really think so？ I mean, we are newlyweds!
Hmm... I guess so. We are newlyweds, after all？
Hey, before getting into bed, let's take a bath, okay？
It was so muggy outside, I got all sweaty. I wanna feel clean for bed.
It was cold outside, wanna warm up once more？ You wanna be nice and cozy before bed, right？
Then let's get ready and head over, okay？
(Phew... Playing newlyweds keeps giving me the wrong idea...)
See you in front of the lobby, then？
I'm gonna go try out the cocoon bath, okay？
Cocoon？ Oh, the sauna! Then ● will too~!
Man, this feels great... Aaah, this is heaven...
A dream!? I almost went to heaven for real...!
Ah, there you are! You took quite a while, didn't you？
Hm？ Your face is pretty red... Did you overheat？ You okay？
(I am definitely never dozing off in a sauna again...)
(There's not much left to do, and all that's left is turning off the lights and sleeping—but still...)
(If ● brings it up, it might give the wrong idea...)
Should we... head to bed soon？
Yeah, let's sleep! I'll turn off the lights, okay？
You were overthinking things, weren't you？ Especially this time... Since it's our honeymoon？
I can't blame you. Even I, when you invited me on this trip—
...wondered if maybe you meant *that*, just a little bit...
That's fine, right？ We can go at our own pace... Still just the two of us, the way we are right now...
Whew... My heart was pounding... Hehe, want to talk a bit before we sleep？
(Well... Nothing else left to do. Just turn off the lights and go to sleep...)
Hm？ What's the matter？ You've gone completely quiet.
Hehe, there, there. Come on over here, okay？
All right, just this much for now...
(Glad I woke up early. Going to bed at a good time paid off!)
(I'll let her sleep a little longer...)
So cute, ▼. But it's about time you woke up, you know~？
I'm gonna play a little prank on you~ Is that okay~？
Hehe, it's wifey's tickle alarm clock♪ Time to wake up, okay？ Darling ▼
Could you stay facing away for just a bit longer？
Hehe, looks like breakfast has started. Shall we go？
All right... Okay, you can look now？
Looks like breakfast is ready. Shall we go？
Right, you need to get changed too, ●!
Nope？ Just thinking you're such a good boy. Even though we're newlyweds.
Mmm... smells so good! They have fresh-baked bread!
You got quite a lot yourself, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Well, I'm hungry! Plus we have lots of places to visit today, right？ Hehe!
Hey, hey, don't fresh-baked croissants totally feel like newlyweds？
I wonder why？ Look, it's so warm, and it tastes like pure love？
I'll feed you so you can really tell. Say 'ahh' ▼
Thank you very much. We look forward to having you again.
Hakone Lake Hotel was such a nice place to stay.
I'd love to come back. Oh... Hey, let's take a photo before we go？
All right! First up, the ropeway to Owakudani!
Sorry to keep you waiting! I got the tickets.
Look, it's going around and around？
It's the end of the line. This is where it loops back.
Oh, right! It's like an amusement park, how exciting♪
Hey, do you think we'll see Mt. Fuji today too？
The weather's so nice, so I bet we will.
Good. Then... I hope it's just the two of us again today♪
Look... What an amazing view. There's even smoke coming out of the ground...
...Hm？ Look over there! Hey, that's Mount Fuji, right!？ It's huge...
It's kind of surreal... Almost a little scary...
Hey... Since nobody else is here, can I snuggle up close to you？
Did you get scared？ Sure, come here.
Thanks. Having my hubby around at times like this is so reassuring. Hehe♪
We will soon be arriving at Owakudani Station. For the ropeway toward Sounzan...
Whoa... It really is an incredible view...
Mount Fuji looks so huge, too...
Hey, hey. I got scared again.
We will soon be arriving at Owakudani Station. For the ropeway toward Sounzan...
We're here... Whoa, so this is Owakudani!!
Amazing... Oh, look, look, the smoke!
The yellow stuff on the ground is sulfur, right？ Is that what smells？
Mmm... Definitely not a smell fit for a honeymoon...
Whoa, the smoke is really billowing out...
Looks like there are spots bubbling up, too？
Here we are, Owakudani! Let's go!
Good boy. Such a good hubby▼
Ugh... I can't take this smell...
Feels like my nose is going crazy...
Still, if you come to Hakone, you've gotta visit here, right？
Huh？ Even if it's not romantic？
Yeah, but it's a spiritual power spot, you know？
Yep. Next up is egg power! Hehe♪
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I got the black eggs.
Yeah, yeah, those! Oh, they really are pitch black, hehe!
Then you're on peeling duty, okay？
I'll be on cooling-it-off duty, okay？ Hehe▼
Hot hot...! Once we eat this, we'll head back to Togendai. Yikes, hot!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you get scared again？
I'm totally fine now, so there~! Hehe.
We will soon arrive at Togendai Station. Transfer for Hakone Sightseeing Cruise, Hakone-machi...
It's a little early, but wanna grab lunch here before the pirate ship？
Okay~! I wonder if any seats with a lake view are open？
